Name: Pharaoh-nechoh
Summary: Pharaoh-nechoh, also called Neco, was king of Egypt when Judah's last kings fell. He killed King Josiah at Megiddo, deposed Jehoahaz after three months, and set up Jehoiakim as a tributary king. He is the pharaoh Jeremiah names in the oracle against Egypt at Carchemish.
RelatedPeople: King Josiah; Jehoahaz, King of Judah; Jehoiakim, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Even great kings fall when they fight battles God did not send them to.
